Crank 'N Drank

Austin, TX · South Austin · Mountain bike

Crank 'N Drank is a mountain bike group ride in Austin, TX. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from ATX Bikes (MTBATX's list says meet behind the shop). About 15 miles, four groups of varying speed; pick one you can hang with.

For visitors

This is a drop ride and riders must be self-sufficient. Bring a cooler, a chair and cash for Dominos, Tacodeli or TCBY after. Route info is at mtbatx.com. The shop's page doesn't give the meeting spot; MTBATX's list says behind the shop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: four groups of varying speed; pick one you can hang with. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Crank 'N Drank group ride

A South Austin Tuesday-night mountain bike tradition run by ATX Bikes. About 15 miles in four pace groups over everything from flowy singletrack to rock gardens. Drop ride. A cooler and chair hangout in the lot follows.
